anchors: Corrosion effects can be accurately predicted when the environment is consistent over the test period.
meaning_zh: 试片法准确预测腐蚀效果以整个试验期环境一致为条件。
required_semantics: 环境在整个测试期一致；准确预测为条件性陈述。
scope_reason: 预测准确性与环境一致的条件；Schema没有InspectionMethod的准确度/适用性关系，排除故障关系召回分母。

source_witnesses.text:
Corrosion effects can be accurately predicted when the environment is consistent over the
                      test period.

anchors: Common sensors will be acceptable for any functions other than shutdown functions and automatic start/changeover of the required pumps
meaning_zh: 共用传感器的许可不适用于停机功能和所列必需泵的自动启动/切换。
required_semantics: 许可排除停机功能及所列必需泵自动启动/切换，保持例外作用域。
scope_reason: 共用传感器法规许可/例外没有直接对应关系；不得借specified_by伪造许可关系。

source_witnesses.text:
Common sensors will be acceptable for
                 any functions other than shutdown functions and automatic start/changeover of the required
                 pumps

anchors: Stop the pump (set) immediately.
Eliminate the causes before returning the pump set to service.
meaning_zh: 异常时立即停泵；重新投运之前须消除原因，不能拆成无前后关系的独立建议。
required_semantics: 异常/损坏语境；立即停泵；消除原因在重新投运之前；不得添加强制重启。
scope_reason: 现有故障→措施可表达两个动作；跨记录时序另作保留诊断。

source_witnesses.text: Eliminate the causes before returning the pump set to service.

anchors: For safety reasons the pump is only allowed to operate against closed discharge valve for a short time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80 °C for standard pumps).
meaning_zh: 标准泵闭出口运行的许可同时受最长5分钟、最高80°C约束；不据此提供现场操作授权。
required_semantics: 标准泵；闭出口；最长5分钟 AND 最高80°C；不构成现场操作许可。
scope_reason: 泵→operates_under→闭出口状态，许可限制可在端点/条件/证据保存。

source_witnesses.text:
For safety reasons the pump is only allowed to operate against closed discharge valve for a short
                                                                                  
      time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80 °C for standard pumps).

anchors: No holes or screen openings on the motor bracket can be covered by insulation.
meaning_zh: 保温时不得覆盖电机支架孔或网罩开口；不能表示成正向覆盖建议。
required_semantics: 电机支架孔/网罩开口；保温场景；不得覆盖。
scope_reason: 部件维护/保温禁令可作负向动作，不得改成正向覆盖。

source_witnesses.text:
No holes or screen openings on the motor
     bracket can be covered by insulation.

anchors: Motor (non drive end) >10 >15
Vibration trip level
meaning_zh: DESMI建议电机非驱动端振动跳机阈值为>15 mm/s，需保留测点、量纲与适用范围。
required_semantics: 电机非驱动端；建议跳机而非报警；严格>15 mm/s；DESMI局部范围。
scope_reason: 沿用现有Component inspected_by InspectionMethod候选作为可检验假设；跳机阈值不是普适故障因果。

anchors: Water flow is very low, the bubble pump is blocked
Make sure that flow is increased or a smaller pump is used
meaning_zh: 对应表格情形的措施为增加流量或使用较小泵，是替代方案，不是两项必做。
required_semantics: 对应低流量/堵塞表格分支；增加流量 OR 使用较小泵，不能变成AND。
scope_reason: 故障/原因到MaintenanceAction可保留复合替代措施。

anchors: Ispezionare le facce delle tenute verificando che non siano usurate e controllare le condizioni degli elastomeri. Sostituirle se necessario oppure prenderne nota per la manutenzione programmata.
meaning_zh: 检查密封面磨损与弹性体状态，必要时替换，或记录以安排维护；保留条件与替代分支。
required_semantics: 密封面磨损、弹性体状态检查；必要时替换 OR 记录待计划维护；指代对象一致。
scope_reason: 部件检查及必要维修在Schema内。

anchors: Before attempting toopenor service the pump:
Allow the pump to completely cool if overheated.
meaning_zh: 检修/开泵前，若已过热应先完全冷却；不是任何工况都必须冷却的无条件建议。
required_semantics: 开泵/检修之前；IF 已过热 THEN 完全冷却，不能无条件化。
scope_reason: 过热/部件到冷却维护动作可表达。

witnesses.text: Before attempting toopenor service the
pump:
Allow the pump to completely cool
if overheated.

anchors: Operation of the pump under conditions differing widely from those, on which the pump selection was based, may result in cavitation or shortened life of bearings, seals, packing, and shaft.
meaning_zh: 偏离选型依据的工况可能造成汽蚀或部件寿命缩短，需保留工况和可能性。
required_semantics: 偏离选型工况；may；汽蚀或轴承/密封/填料/轴寿命缩短；非必然后果。
scope_reason: OperatingCondition causes FaultMode已有关系可表达。

source_witnesses.text:
Operation of the pump under conditions differing widely from those, on
       which the pump selection was based, may result in cavitation or shortened life of bearings,
       seals, packing, and shaft.

anchors: Extreme dirt
Dry
Light to medium
Slow to medium
Daily flushing out dirt
meaning_zh: 原表极脏、干燥、轻至中负载、低至中速、0–200°F的工况行对应每日冲排污物；不把周期脱离同一行条件。
required_semantics: 同一行：极脏、干、轻至中负载、低至中速、0–200°F→每日冲排污物；不能跨行。
scope_reason: 轴承维护政策及作用条件可表达；原OperatingCondition mitigated_by类型本身不合法。

anchors: Om annat fett används kan intervallen förkortas.
meaning_zh: 使用其他润滑脂时，补充润滑周期可能缩短；非无条件强制缩短。
required_semantics: 使用其他润滑脂时，周期可能缩短；非确定强制缩短。
scope_reason: 电机/轴承补充润滑政策可在维护动作文字中表达。

witnesses.text: Om annat

anchors: Om referensresistansen inte kan uppnås är lindningen för fuktig och måste torkas i ugn.
90°C under 12-16 timmar, följt av 105 °C under 6-8 timmar.
meaning_zh: 达不到参考绝缘电阻时，绕组按90°C、12–16h后接105°C、6–8h的顺序烘干。
required_semantics: 参考电阻未达到；先90°C×12–16h，后105°C×6–8h；温度/时长必须成对且有序。
scope_reason: 潮湿绕组→烘干措施可表达，参数为动作限定。

anchors: Flow straigheners are for clear liquids applications only.
meaning_zh: 流动整流器仅用于清液工况；不能推荐为全部输送介质通用措施。
required_semantics: 整流器仅清液适用；only不可删除。

source_witnesses.text: Flow straigheners are for clear liquids applications only.

anchors: a relief valve mounted directly on the pump, an in-line pressure relief valve, a torque limiting device, or a rupture disk.
If pump rotation may be reversed during operation, pressure protection must be provided on both sides of pump.
meaning_zh: 压力保护允许四类替代手段；泵可能反转时须双侧保护；条件与分支都不能删除。
required_semantics: 四种压力保护替代：泵上阀/管路阀/扭矩限制/爆破盘；可能反转时双侧保护。
scope_reason: 风险防护/维修措施可表达；单纯传感器监测不等于压力保护。

meaning_zh: 泄压阀不得用于流量控制或出口压力调节，不能转写为肯定用途。
required_semantics: 不可用于流量控制，也不可用于出口压力调节；在辅助要求中完整保留。
scope_reason: 禁止泄压阀用于某功能属于用途/运行限制；当前没有用途/许可关系，不强塞成维护或因果。
